title: Ugly Games
summary: Online arcade: Chess, Tetris, Poker, Stratego, Bomberman, crossplay with the web
description:
Ugly Games is an online arcade hub for the CardputerZero. The home screen lists the public rooms waiting for players across all games, live.
Crossplay with M5StickS3 or CardputerADV.

Games: Tetris, Chess (online, 1-day or live), Blackjack, Poker (with bots), Stratego, Scorch and Bomberman.

Rooms are shared with uglygames.online and the Cardputer ADV, so you can play against people on a PC, a phone or another device. Rooms can be public or private (4-letter code). No registration needed: choose a nickname; an optional free site account adds the chess ranking.

Keys: F up, Z left, X down, C right, Space/Enter confirm, Esc back. Requires Wi-Fi.
